en.title: Find Reciprocal
en.description: Given an integer N, find the decimal expansion of 1/N. Output the non-repeating prefix of the decimal plus one copy of the repeating cycle, then, after a space, the repeating cycle once more. A terminating decimal is treated as having the repeating cycle 0.
en.input: The input is an integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^5).
en.output: Output `0.`, the non-repeating prefix, one copy of the repeating cycle, a space, and the second copy of the repeating cycle. If the decimal terminates, the repeating cycle is 0.
en.explanation: Record the position where each remainder first appears during long division; the cycle starts where a remainder repeats. When the remainder is 0, the remaining decimal digits repeat 0 forever.
hints: Do not use floating-point numbers; generate the decimal digits from the remainders.
For a terminating decimal, the repeating cycle is taken as 0, following the two examples.
